captureContract.demoSequence: Sandboxed Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 spawn with `-playdemo demoN` for each of N in {1, 2, 3}; the demo plays deterministically from its WAD lump (no input injection required); per checkpoint tic the runner schedules a frame capture via the canonical 12-step GDI BitBlt/GetDIBits pipeline (sourced from windowCaptureProbe.ts), waits for the elapsed-ms target (capturedAtElapsedMs = checkpointTic * (1000/35)) plus checkpointLeadMs override, captures the client area into a width*height*4 BGRA buffer, computes SHA-256 of the captured-native buffer and of the 320x200 nearest-neighbour normalized buffer; kills the subprocess after the last checkpoint, waits killWaitMs for clean exit, destroys the sandbox.
captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/capture-reference-demo-sync.test.ts pins the static surface (DEMO_LUMP_NAMES + DEMO_PLAYBACK_NUMBERS + DEMO_CHECKPOINT_CONTRACTS + runner arity + error class shapes + frozen contract structure matching capture-demoN-playback-checkpoints.json fixtures) and gates the live three-demo capture on every REFERENCE_SANDBOX_POLICY.requiredFiles entry being present; when gated in, spawns three sandboxed DOOM.EXE processes back-to-back with -playdemo demo1/2/3, captures per-checkpoint frames, and asserts non-decreasing per-checkpoint timestamps + SHA-256 hex shape + clean shutdown.
